description: The file defines the 'InterviewDecorator' class, which provides a wrapper around the Interview entity for additional functionalities such as setting related entities and formatting interview data.

classes.name: InterviewDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing enhanced manipulation and formatting capabilities for Interview entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a specific Interview object.

methods.name: setCandidateVacancyById
methods.description: Associates a CandidateVacancy entity with the Interview by its ID.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Associates a Candidate entity with the Interview by its ID.

methods.name: setInterviewerByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Adds multiple Employee entities as interviewers based on their employee numbers.

methods.name: addInterviewer
methods.description: Adds a single Employee as an interviewer if not already added.

methods.name: removeInterviewers
methods.description: Removes all interviewers from the Interview.

methods.name: getInterviewDate
methods.description: Returns the interview date formatted as a string.

methods.name: getInterviewTime
methods.description: Returns the interview time formatted as a string or null if not set.
